verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first Rust library whose public API (types, traits, methods) is documented in in-depth reference docs with inline examples. Those docs are fully static and crawlable on docs.rs, and the product is driven entirely through a cargo dependency with no editor required. A first-party Bevy Remote Protocol also exists for runtime control. Missing for 10: API stability (pre-1.0 with breaking changes every release), richer docs beyond reference and examples (community reports thin documentation), and first-party documentation evidence for the Remote Protocol.
